description: This file defines API routes for managing events in an event management system. It includes CRUD operations with validation and business rules such as time consistency, capacity constraints, and ownership checks. The routes are built using FastAPI and interact with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing an event, including fields like title, description, location, start_time, end_time, capacity, owner_id.

classes.name: Attendee
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model representing an attendee of an event, including fields like event_id.

classes.name: User
classes.description: SQLAlchemy model for user entity, including at least an 'id' field.

methods.name: _validate_event_times(start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime)
methods.description: Internal function to ensure that end_time is after start_time, raises HTTPException if not.

methods.name: create_event( payload: EventCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new event with validation on time range, owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: list_events( db: Session = Depends(get_db), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search query for title"), skip: int = Query(default=0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset"), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100, description="Pagination limit"), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of events, with optional search on the title.

methods.name: get_event(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by its ID.

methods.name: update_event( event_id: int, payload: EventUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates event details, with validation on time and capacity, ensuring only the owner can update.

methods.name: delete_event( event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes an event if the requester is the owner.

ctags.signature: ( event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
